If you love your dogs, DO NOT visit this place. I had seen it from the outside and wanted to take my dogs (we rescued one of them a month ago). He's a little scared because he was mistreated, but he's an angel. We told the guy who received him that he had been abused and that he had to be especially careful with him. The second someone came in, he tied him up terribly to start cutting his hair, and when he tried to straighten him up, he threw him down. My dog ​​not only fell but also hit his head really badly on the glass door. On top of everything, the woman I think is the owner was there, along with the other workers, and nobody did anything. It seemed like it was normal because they didn't even offer us an apology. I literally had to go into the grooming booth, pick up my dog, and leave the place.
It's no use having a "pretty" place if everything there is awful, including the way the animals are treated.
